title: MARKET STALL HANDOFF
description: Farmers now pass purchased goods across the stall with a small wrapped bundle animation, a wooden stamp sound, and exactly enough ceremony to make buying carrots feel official.
consequence: The market gets a better handshake. The carrots leave with ceremony.

title: CATALOG WINDOW SHOPPING
description: Furniture previews now let players place ghost versions of premium items in their home, walk around them, adjust the lighting, and then leave without confirming the purchase.
consequence: The room gets to rehearse before anything becomes furniture.

title: DEATH SCREEN SKIN INSPECT
description: After a wipe, the death recap now rotates the killer's weapon skin for three seconds before showing damage numbers, complete with rarity flare and a tiny store tag.
consequence: The autopsy pauses to admire the merchandise.

title: SHOWROOM DOOR ANIMATION
description: Vehicle previews now begin with a slow unskippable door-open sequence, followed by a camera orbit that lingers on the cup holders before reaching the engine sound test.
consequence: The test drive starts with interior monologue.
